text.body: || añjanaśailanāthastotram || pulakini bhujamadhye pūjayantaṃ purandhrīṃ bhuvananayanapuṇyaṃ pūritāśeṣakāmam | punarapi vṛṣaśaile phullanīlotpalābhaṃ puruṣamanubhaveyaṃ puṇḍarīkāyatākṣam || 1|| ājānasauhṛdamapārakṛpāmṛtābdhiṃ avyājavatsalamavelasuśīlamādyam | ānandarāśimanurāgamayāvarodhaṃ ārādhayāmi harimañjanaśailanātham || 2|| ātāmrapādamavadātasuvarṇacelaṃ āpīnabāhuśikharojjvalaśaṅkhacakram | āvissmitānanamamandadayākaṭākṣaṃ ārādhayāmi harimañjanaśailanātham || 3|| aprākṛtāvayavasaṃhitasaṃniveśaṃ ārūḍhayauvanamahīnakumārabhāvam | amlānakāntimativāṅmanasānubhāvaṃ ārādhayāmi harimañjanaśailanātham || 4|| āśāvakāśasamuditvarasarvagandhaṃ āsvādayatsugamasarvarasasvabhāvam | āśleṣagamyasukhasaṃspṛśanātirekaṃ ārādhayāmi harimañjanaśailanātham || 5|| ādarśayantamatisaṃkucitākṣiśaktiṃ āśrāvayantamakhilān badhirān prakṛtyā | ābhāṣayantamabhito natamūkavargaṃ ārādhayāmi harimañjanaśailanātham || 6|| ādhāvayantamatimārutameva paṅgūn ājānulambibhujayantamaho kubāhūn | anyāṃśca kṛtaśirasaḥ pratijīvayantaṃ ārādhayāmi harimañjanaśailanātham || 7|| ājanmanirdhanajanānalakeśayantaṃ ajñānapi tridaśadeśikadeśyayantam | ahnāya vandhyamapi martyamavandhyayantaṃ ārādhayāmi harimañjanaśailanātham || 8|| ābaddhakaṅkaṇamaśeṣaśaraṇyatāyāṃ āpatsahāyamaparādhasahaṃ natānām | āsannasāmagasukhālasasūrivargaṃ ārādhayāmi harimañjanaśailanātham || 9|| adhyāsitāsanasarojasanūpurāṅ ghriṃ āmuktavīrakaṭakāyatavṛttajaṅgham | āścaryajānuyugamapratimorukāṇḍaṃ ārādhayāmi harimañjanaśailanātham || 10|| āvartinimnanikhilāṇḍanidānanābhiṃ āyāmidorvivarakeligṛhāvarodham | ābaddharatnamayabhūṣabhujācatuṣkaṃ ārādhayāmi harimañjanaśailanātham || 11|| aṃsāvalambimaṇikuṇḍalakāntagaṇḍaṃ āvissmitāṃśumadhurādharabandhujīvam | āsyābjasaurabhasamutsukadīrghanāsaṃ ārādhayāmi harimañjanaśailanātham || 12|| ardhendubhāsvadalikollasadūrdhvapuṇḍraṃ ālolanīlakuṭilālakacāruvaktram | āvirmayūkhamaṇicūḍamahākirīṭaṃ ārādhayāmi harimañjanaśailanātham || 13|| vādibhītikarāryeṇa racitā bhāvabandha taḥ śobhate veṅkaṭādrīśaviṣayā stutiradbhutā || || iti añjanaśailanāthastotraṃ saṃpūrṇam ||
